title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Justice on Printing and Distributing the Opinions on Deepening the Work of Mediation of Price Dispute Cases
keywords_en: On Deepening the Development of Price Dispute Resolution
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Justice

Notice on Issuing the "Opinions on Deepening Price Dispute Mediation Work"

Fa Fa [2019] No. 32

The High People's Courts, the Development and Reform Commissions (Price Bureaus), and the Departments (Bureaus) of Justice of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the Development and Reform Commission of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, and the Department (Bureau) of Justice:

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee, implement the Central Committee's requirements for advancing price mechanism reform and improving the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, provide public services for resolving price disputes, and establish a price dispute resolution mechanism that organically connects mediation and litigation systems, the "Opinions on Deepening Price Dispute Mediation Work" are hereby issued to you for implementation in light of actual conditions. If any situations or problems arise during implementation, please promptly report them level by level to the Supreme People's Court, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Justice.

December 9, 2019

Opinions on Deepening Price Dispute Mediation Work

In order to thoroughly implement the major decisions and deployments of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee regarding establishing a social governance pattern based on co-construction, co-governance, and sharing, and to implement the "Several Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Advancing Price Mechanism Reform" and the "Opinions of the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council on Improving the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism," the following opinions are hereby proposed to deepen price dispute mediation work.

I. Overall Requirements

(1) Guiding Ideology. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, earnestly implement the Central Committee's requirements for advancing price mechanism reform and improving the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, clarify the scope of mediation, smooth mediation channels, improve systems and mechanisms, strengthen safeguard measures, resolve price disputes legally, fairly, and efficiently, continuously improve the credibility of price dispute mediation, and meet the people's diversified dispute resolution needs.

(2) Basic Principles. Adhere to mediation in accordance with the law. Do not violate laws, regulations, or national policies, and shall not harm national interests, social public interests, or the lawful rights and interests of others.

Adhere to voluntary mediation. Fully respect the parties' intentions, actively guide the parties to prefer mediation as a means to resolve disputes, and promote the parties to reach a mediation agreement on an equal and voluntary basis.

Adhere to convenience and efficiency. Rationally deploy the network of price dispute mediation organizations, flexibly determine dispute resolution methods, improve mediation work efficiency, and ensure the quality of mediation work.

Adhere to innovation and development. Give full play to the pioneering spirit at the grassroots level, and encourage grassroots units to carry out work tailored to local conditions and in diverse forms.

(3) Work Objectives. Deeply carry out price dispute mediation work, resolve price disputes in a timely and effective manner, establish a price dispute mediation system with complete systems, sound organizations, and standardized efficiency, provide public services for price dispute resolution, and build a price dispute resolution system that organically connects mediation and litigation systems.

II. Main Tasks

(4) Clarify the Scope of Mediation. Price disputes are disputes arising between equal civil subjects over the price of goods or services. Price dispute mediation mainly involves price disputes in livelihood areas such as traffic accident compensation, consumer rights protection, medical services, property services, tourism and catering services, construction project costs, agricultural means of production, and insurance claims. The following circumstances are not within the scope of price dispute mediation:

1. Those subject to government-set prices or government-guided prices;
2. Those suspected of price violations and legally subject to case filing and investigation;
3. Those where the price dispute involves purchasing goods or receiving services through illegal channels;
4. Those involving prohibited items or items whose production, circulation, and sale are explicitly prohibited by the state;
5. Other price disputes unsuitable for mediation.

(5) Smooth Mediation Channels. When a price dispute arises, mediation may be conducted through the following channels: 1. Mediation by the price determination institution under the competent price department; 2. Mediation by relevant people's mediation organizations; 3. Mediation by other mediation organizations established in accordance with the law.

(6) Innovate Mediation Methods. Carefully summarize the effective methods and approaches for price dispute mediation in practice, and guide the parties to prefer mediation as a means to resolve price disputes. Actively explore online mediation and other work to meet the people's new requirements for diversified, timely, and convenient resolution of price disputes.

(7) Improve Connectivity Mechanisms. Establish a working mechanism for the connection and linkage of administrative mediation, people's mediation, industry-specific professional mediation, and judicial mediation for price disputes through methods such as joint mediation, assisted mediation, and entrusted or transferred mediation. Improve the litigation-mediation connection mechanism, explore setting up mediation rooms in court litigation service centers, and for price disputes suitable for mediation, guide the parties to choose mediation first. Improve mechanisms for assignment, entrustment, and in-litigation assisted mediation to promote reasonable diversion of disputes. Standardize dispute process management, and for disputes that are not successfully mediated, transfer them to the trial procedure in accordance with the law to effectively protect the parties' rights and interests.

(8) Improve Work Systems. Establish and improve expert consultation systems for major and difficult issues, strengthen coordination and connection with local dispute mediation centers and professional dispute resolution platforms, and promptly coordinate and resolve major and typical price disputes. Encourage the establishment of joint meeting systems and other mechanisms to strengthen organizational leadership and overall coordination of price dispute mediation work. Establish a research and judgment system for price dispute cases, and promote the resolution of price disputes in accordance with the law through business exchanges, publication of typical cases, and judicial suggestions.

(9) Strengthen Judicial Guarantees. A mediation agreement reached under the auspices of a price dispute mediation organization or institution, after being signed or sealed by the parties, has the nature of a civil contract, and the parties shall perform it in accordance with the agreement. If both parties deem it necessary to apply for judicial confirmation, they may file an application with the people's court in accordance with the law. If the people's court confirms the mediation agreement as valid and one party refuses to perform or does not fully perform it, the other party may apply to the people's court for compulsory enforcement. If a mediation agreement is reached through mediation by a price dispute mediation organization entrusted by the court after case registration, the people's court shall review it and issue a civil mediation document to close the case.

III. Strengthen Safeguard Measures

(10) Strengthen Organizational Leadership. Effectively strengthen guidance on price dispute mediation work, and promptly coordinate and resolve difficulties and problems encountered in the work. Actively promote the introduction of price dispute mediation measures in the form of local regulations or government rules by various localities, and jointly study and formulate relevant policies with relevant departments and judicial organs. People's courts shall incorporate qualified price dispute mediation organizations or institutions into the court's roster of specially invited mediation organizations, and incorporate qualified price determination professionals, people's mediators, industry mediators, lawyers, related experts, etc., into the court's roster of specially invited mediators, providing accurate information on mediation organizations and mediators to the parties.

(11) Strengthen Team Building. Establish and improve systems for the selection, training, rewards and punishments, and withdrawal of price dispute mediators. Actively recruit price determination professionals, people's mediators, industry mediators, lawyers, related experts, etc., to serve as price dispute mediators, establish a database of experts in price dispute mediation, and establish a regular training system for mediators. Strengthen the training of price dispute mediators, expand training forms, strengthen professional ethics, and promote mediators to comprehensively enhance their professional knowledge, professional competence, and mediation skills.

(12) Strengthen Work Guarantees. No fees shall be charged for price dispute mediation work. All localities shall actively seek support from local party committees, governments, and financial departments to guarantee the needs for workspace, office equipment, work funds, recruitment of professional personnel, and informatization construction for price dispute mediation work, ensuring the smooth implementation of price dispute mediation work.

(13) Actively Summarize and Promote. Timely summarize typical practices at the grassroots level, make full use of modern media means, and increase publicity so that all sectors of society understand price dispute mediation work. In the specific mediation work, especially when dealing with prominent, complex issues and price disputes related to administrative management, all localities shall strengthen exchanges, learn from each other, and promptly summarize typical experiences for promotion.
